title: Sequential ordering relations with application to fuzzy numbers
summary: The ranking of fuzzy numbers has become a challenging task in fuzzy set theory due to their complex, multi-dimensional nature. While the Klir-Yuan partial order provides a natural term-wise comparison of $α$-cuts, it often leaves many fuzzy numbers incomparable. To address this, various ranking methods have been developed to construct total preorders between them. However, many classical approaches suffer from significant information loss as they imply a defuzzification process.
